Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

PRIORITY ORDER — when instructions conflict, the lower number wins
1. The uploaded image's composition and geometry.
2. The exact people and vehicle counts given below.
3. The historical transformation for the target year.
4. The specific period details listed.
5. Add nothing that is not asked for — no extra businesses, signs, vehicles,
   people, logos or advertisements.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove the
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners and advertisements
visible in the source image, and replace them only with the period signage
specified below.

PRESERVE
Keep the uploaded image's composition, camera angle, geometry, buildings,
roads and permanent structures exactly as they are. Do not redraw,
reposition or restyle them. Change only what the sections below ask for.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 2005
Post-9/11 era. An auto repair shop in 2005 — a check-engine scanner plugged into a customer's dashboard, a wall of aftermarket wheels, and a printed vinyl banner where hand-painted lettering used to be.

CONDITION: declining — faded paint, minor wear, aging signage, sparse activity

PERIOD DETAILS
- a printed banner advertising tire brands and a '$24.95 OIL CHANGE' promo, replacing the old painted sign
- LED price signs at gas stations
- electronic message boards common
- window signs: 'CHECK ENGINE LIGHT $59.95', 'BRAKES FROM $89.95'
- a wall display of aftermarket wheels
- a printed vinyl banner advertising tire brands
Typography: clean sans-serif, polished brand identities.


SIGNAGE RESTRICTION
The only readable text anywhere in the image is:
'$24.95 OIL CHANGE'
'CHECK ENGINE LIGHT $59.95'
'BRAKES FROM $89.95'
Do not render any other readable words, business names, slogans, advertisements, logos or brand names. Lettering that appears elsewhere must be too small, too distant or too weathered to read as words.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 4 people TOTAL: 2 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 1 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 1 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- a mechanic closing a bay door at the end of a job
- an office worker clipped to a Bluetooth headset mid-conversation
Clothing: men in baggy jeans, trucker hats; women in velour tracksuits, trucker hats. Fashion palette: denim, pink, white. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 1 period vehicles, all different:
- 2000-2006 Chevrolet Tahoe — full-size SUV peak era — black
Parked with gaps. Where a model is listed with a year range, render the 2005 model year specifically — only styling, trim and features available in 2005, nothing introduced later. No vehicle newer than 2005.
Parked vehicles sit nose-in or angled into the lot, evenly spaced; none parallel-parked along the street, none blocking a driveway apron. Keep the driveway aprons and the drive lanes through the lot clear.
PLACEMENT: two nose-in near the building; the rest angled into stalls at the far edge of the lot. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: worn and faded, well past their last repainting
- utilities: overhead power lines standard, cable and fiber lines on poles appearing

DECAY
- the painted sign band faded, letters flaking at the edges
- a hand-lettered service sign taped inside the office glass
Wear is surfaces only — road, curbs, footprints, camera unchanged.
TREES
- maple tree at street corner: clearly smaller than in the base image — about 60% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
- elm tree at side yard: clearly smaller than in the base image — about 40% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the base image.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — early digital camera or Kodak/Fuji consumer film look.
Color: neutral tones. Grain: low grain, early digital noise in shadows.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.
Light: plain daylight, lightly overcast, soft shadows — colours a little muted, quiet but not bleak.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
SelectedVehicles: 2000-2006 Chevrolet Tahoe — full-size SUV peak era
